title: Animals and Plants: Groups, Sounds and Young

explanation.tr:
Hayvan ve bitki kelimelerinde B1 düzeyinde bilinmesi gerekenler:
• Yavrular: cat → kitten, dog → puppy, cow → calf, sheep → lamb, horse → foal, bird → chick
• Gruplar: a herd of cows, a flock of sheep/birds, a pack of wolves, a swarm of bees, a school of fish
• Sesler: dogs bark, cats miaow, cows moo, lions roar, birds sing, bees buzz
• Düzensiz çoğullar: sheep → sheep, fish → fish, mouse → mice, goose → geese
• Bitki: root (kök), stem (gövde), leaf → leaves (yaprak), branch (dal), seed (tohum); plants grow, flowers bloom, trees lose their leaves
explanation.tk:
Haýwan we ösümlik sözlerinde B1 derejesinde bilmeli zatlar:
• Çagalary: cat → kitten, dog → puppy, cow → calf, sheep → lamb, horse → foal, bird → chick
• Toparlar: a herd of cows, a flock of sheep/birds, a pack of wolves, a swarm of bees, a school of fish
• Sesleri: dogs bark, cats miaow, cows moo, lions roar, birds sing, bees buzz
• Düzgünsiz köplük: sheep → sheep, fish → fish, mouse → mice, goose → geese
• Ösümlik: root (kök), stem (baldak), leaf → leaves (ýaprak), branch (şaha), seed (tohum); plants grow, flowers bloom, trees lose their leaves
explanation.ru:
Что нужно знать о животных и растениях на уровне B1:
• Детёныши: cat → kitten, dog → puppy, cow → calf, sheep → lamb, horse → foal, bird → chick
• Группы: a herd of cows, a flock of sheep/birds, a pack of wolves, a swarm of bees, a school of fish
• Звуки: dogs bark, cats miaow, cows moo, lions roar, birds sing, bees buzz
• Неправильное мн. ч.: sheep → sheep, fish → fish, mouse → mice, goose → geese
• Растения: root (корень), stem (стебель), leaf → leaves (лист), branch (ветка), seed (семя); plants grow, flowers bloom, trees lose their leaves

examples.en: Our cat had four kittens.
A flock of sheep crossed the road.
The dog barked all night.

Plant the seeds in spring.

explanation.tr:
Sık karıştırılan kelimeler:
• borrow (ödünç almak) / lend (ödünç vermek): Can I borrow your pen? Can you lend me your pen?
• say (bir şey söylemek) / tell (birine söylemek): She said hello. She told me the truth.
• make (üretmek) / do (yapmak, iş): make a cake, make a mistake / do homework, do the dishes
• lose (kaybetmek) / loose (bol, gevşek)
• bring (buraya getirmek) / take (oraya götürmek)
• remember (hatırlamak) / remind (hatırlatmak)
• rise (kendiliğinden yükselmek) / raise (bir şeyi kaldırmak)
• affect (fiil: etkilemek) / effect (isim: etki)
explanation.tk:
Köp garyşdyrylýan sözler:
• borrow (karz almak) / lend (karz bermek): Can I borrow your pen? Can you lend me your pen?
• say (bir zat aýtmak) / tell (birine aýtmak): She said hello. She told me the truth.
• make (döretmek) / do (etmek, iş): make a cake, make a mistake / do homework, do the dishes
• lose (ýitirmek) / loose (giň, gowşak)
• bring (bu ýere getirmek) / take (ol ýere alyp gitmek)
• remember (ýatlamak) / remind (ýatlatmak)
• rise (öz-özünden galmak) / raise (bir zady galdyrmak)
• affect (işlik: täsir etmek) / effect (at: täsir)
explanation.ru:
Часто путаемые слова:
• borrow (брать взаймы) / lend (давать взаймы): Can I borrow your pen? Can you lend me your pen?
• say (сказать что-то) / tell (сказать кому-то): She said hello. She told me the truth.
• make (создавать) / do (делать, работа): make a cake, make a mistake / do homework, do the dishes
• lose (терять) / loose (свободный, неплотный)
• bring (приносить сюда) / take (уносить туда)
• remember (помнить) / remind (напоминать)
• rise (подниматься самому) / raise (поднимать что-то)
• affect (глагол: влиять) / effect (сущ.: эффект)

explanation.tr:
Gelenekleri anlatırken kullanılan yapılar:
• Genel alışkanlık: Present Simple: People eat turkey at Christmas.
• Gelenek / beklenti: be supposed to, it is traditional to, it's customary to: You're supposed to take off your shoes.
• Pasif: Eggs are painted at Easter. Gifts are exchanged.
• Geçmiş alışkanlık: used to: People used to light candles.
Kelimeler: celebrate (kutlamak), festival, custom (âdet), tradition, ceremony (tören), wedding, anniversary, fireworks, decorate (süslemek), exchange gifts, wish someone a happy…
Edatlar: AT Christmas/Easter, ON Christmas Day/New Year's Eve, IN December
explanation.tk:
Däp-dessurlary beýan edende ulanylýan gurluşlar:
• Umumy endik: Present Simple: People eat turkey at Christmas.
• Däp / garaşylýan zat: be supposed to, it is traditional to, it's customary to: You're supposed to take off your shoes.
• Passiw: Eggs are painted at Easter. Gifts are exchanged.
• Geçmiş endik: used to: People used to light candles.
Sözler: celebrate (bellemek), festival, custom (adat), tradition, ceremony (dabara), wedding, anniversary, fireworks, decorate (bezemek), exchange gifts, wish someone a happy…
Predloglar: AT Christmas/Easter, ON Christmas Day/New Year's Eve, IN December
explanation.ru:
Конструкции для описания традиций:
• Общая привычка: Present Simple: People eat turkey at Christmas.
• Обычай / ожидание: be supposed to, it is traditional to, it's customary to: You're supposed to take off your shoes.
• Пассив: Eggs are painted at Easter. Gifts are exchanged.
• Привычка в прошлом: used to: People used to light candles.
Слова: celebrate (праздновать), festival, custom (обычай), tradition, ceremony (церемония), wedding, anniversary, fireworks, decorate (украшать), exchange gifts, wish someone a happy…
Предлоги: AT Christmas/Easter, ON Christmas Day/New Year's Eve, IN December

title: Dates, Numbers and Telling the Time

explanation.tr:
Tarih: yazılış (BrE) 21 March 2026, okunuş: the twenty-first of March. AmE: March 21 → March twenty-first. Sıra sayıları: 1st first, 2nd second, 3rd third, 12th twelfth, 20th twentieth, 22nd twenty-second.
Yıllar: 1995 = nineteen ninety-five, 2008 = two thousand and eight, 2026 = twenty twenty-six.
Sayılar: 345 = three hundred AND forty-five (BrE), 2,500 = two thousand five hundred; hundred/thousand/million çoğul -s almaz: two hundred people (ama: hundreds of people).
Ondalık: 2.5 = two point five. Telefon: 0 = 'oh'.
Saat: 7:15 quarter past seven, 7:30 half past seven, 7:45 quarter to eight, 7:20 twenty past seven, 7:40 twenty to eight. Edatlar: AT 7 o'clock, ON Monday / on 5 May, IN May / in 2026 / in the morning.
explanation.tk:
Sene: ýazylyşy (BrE) 21 March 2026, okalyşy: the twenty-first of March. AmE: March 21 → March twenty-first. Tertip sanlary: 1st first, 2nd second, 3rd third, 12th twelfth, 20th twentieth, 22nd twenty-second.
Ýyllar: 1995 = nineteen ninety-five, 2008 = two thousand and eight, 2026 = twenty twenty-six.
Sanlar: 345 = three hundred AND forty-five (BrE), 2,500 = two thousand five hundred; hundred/thousand/million köplük -s almaýar: two hundred people (emma: hundreds of people).
Onluk droblar: 2.5 = two point five. Telefon: 0 = 'oh'.
Sagat: 7:15 quarter past seven, 7:30 half past seven, 7:45 quarter to eight, 7:20 twenty past seven, 7:40 twenty to eight. Predloglar: AT 7 o'clock, ON Monday / on 5 May, IN May / in 2026 / in the morning.
explanation.ru:
Дата: запись (BrE) 21 March 2026, чтение: the twenty-first of March. AmE: March 21 → March twenty-first. Порядковые: 1st first, 2nd second, 3rd third, 12th twelfth, 20th twentieth, 22nd twenty-second.
Годы: 1995 = nineteen ninety-five, 2008 = two thousand and eight, 2026 = twenty twenty-six.
Числа: 345 = three hundred AND forty-five (BrE), 2,500 = two thousand five hundred; hundred/thousand/million без -s: two hundred people (но: hundreds of people).
Дроби: 2.5 = two point five. Телефон: 0 = 'oh'.
Время: 7:15 quarter past seven, 7:30 half past seven, 7:45 quarter to eight, 7:20 twenty past seven, 7:40 twenty to eight. Предлоги: AT 7 o'clock, ON Monday / on 5 May, IN May / in 2026 / in the morning.

topic: Grammar & Vocabulary: English Around the World
title: British and American English

explanation.tr:
İngilizce 60'tan fazla ülkede resmî dildir. En belirgin farklar İngiliz (BrE) ve Amerikan (AmE) İngilizcesi arasındadır:
• Kelime: flat/apartment, lift/elevator, biscuit/cookie, holiday/vacation, rubbish/trash, autumn/fall, mobile/cell phone, underground/subway, petrol/gas, chips/fries
• Yazım: colour/color, centre/center, travelled/traveled, organise/organize, programme/program
• Dilbilgisi: BrE have got / AmE have; BrE I've just eaten / AmE I just ate; at the weekend / on the weekend
• Tarih: BrE 5/3 = 5 March, AmE 5/3 = May 3
explanation.tk:
Iňlis dili 60-dan gowrak ýurtda resmi dil. Iň görnükli tapawutlar Britan (BrE) we Amerikan (AmE) iňlis diliniň arasynda:
• Söz: flat/apartment, lift/elevator, biscuit/cookie, holiday/vacation, rubbish/trash, autumn/fall, mobile/cell phone, underground/subway, petrol/gas, chips/fries
• Ýazylyş: colour/color, centre/center, travelled/traveled, organise/organize, programme/program
• Grammatika: BrE have got / AmE have; BrE I've just eaten / AmE I just ate; at the weekend / on the weekend
• Sene: BrE 5/3 = 5-nji mart, AmE 5/3 = 3-nji maý
explanation.ru:
Английский — официальный язык более чем в 60 странах. Главные различия — между британским (BrE) и американским (AmE) вариантами:
• Лексика: flat/apartment, lift/elevator, biscuit/cookie, holiday/vacation, rubbish/trash, autumn/fall, mobile/cell phone, underground/subway, petrol/gas, chips/fries
• Орфография: colour/color, centre/center, travelled/traveled, organise/organize, programme/program
• Грамматика: BrE have got / AmE have; BrE I've just eaten / AmE I just ate; at the weekend / on the weekend
• Даты: BrE 5/3 = 5 марта, AmE 5/3 = 3 мая
